Book correction: The answer key prints "(i) f is discontinuous at x = 2". This is wrong: at x = 2 the left hand limit is 2^2 - 1 = 3, the right hand limit is 3 and f(2) = 3, so f is continuous at x = 2. The key's "(ii) f is discontinuous at x = -2" is correct.
